whiteLabelBot.title: Your channel's own bot
whiteLabelBot.description: Chat as your own bot account instead of the shared NomNomzBot. Viewers see your bot's name and picture.
whiteLabelBot.loadFailed: The bot account could not be loaded.
whiteLabelBot.disconnectedToast: Your bot account is disconnected. The shared bot speaks again.
whiteLabelBot.disconnectFailed: The bot account could not be disconnected.
whiteLabelBot.browserFailed: The Twitch sign-in could not be started.

shared.title: Shared bot
shared.description: Your channel uses the shared NomNomzBot account.

connect.title: Connect a bot account
connect.description: Sign in on Twitch as the account that should speak for your channel.

replace.title: Use another account
replace.description: Sign in as a different bot account. It replaces the current one.

browser.title: Sign in with the browser
browser.description: Open the Twitch sign-in page here, if you can not use a code.

disconnect.title: Go back to the shared bot
disconnect.description: Your own bot account stops speaking in your channel.
disconnect.confirmDescription: Your channel goes back to the shared bot.
disconnect.consequenceShared: The shared bot answers commands and events in your channel again.
disconnect.consequenceAccount: The Twitch account itself stays as it is. You can connect it again at any time.

login.instruction: Open {site} and type this code. Sign in as the bot account, not as yourself.
login.botAccountHint: Use a private window if you are signed in to Twitch as yourself.
login.waiting: Waiting for you to approve the code...
login.expired: The code ran out of time. Start again to get a new one.
login.denied: The sign-in was denied on Twitch.
login.error: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
